scope: Python runtime modules under core plus public top-level facades
review_policy: The local quality suite enforces these limits; GitHub CI is disabled. runtime_lines is 19108 to cover path-safe, non-overwriting artifact backups, atomic job/lane recovery, bounded resume attempts, and blocking multi-agent approval when executable commands are hidden; revisit after removing comparable runtime code.
